# [CS082] Use bytes.Equal (go.style.bytes-equal)

bytes.Compare(a, b) == 0 tests two byte slices for equality.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | INFO |
| **Category** | Style |
| **CWE** | - |
| **OWASP** | - |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | Yes |

## Why It Matters in Go

bytes.Equal says what is tested and does not compute an ordering. For secrets such as tokens or MACs use subtle.ConstantTimeCompare or hmac.Equal instead; see auth-non-constant-time-compare. The fix rewrites the comparison.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
same := bytes.Compare(got, want) == 0
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
same := bytes.Equal(got, want)
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [go.style.bytes-equal]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    go.style.bytes-equal: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore go.style.bytes-equal -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** go.style.bytes-equal
```
